comparison.objective: Join two framing struts square by pushing one onto a connector until its catch latches, then lift-test and set down the assembly; candidate removes and recovers tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Strut task tests bimanual stabilization, linear insertion, snap-latching, squareness, and assembly integrity; candidate tests recessed coaxial tool alignment, hammering, force regulation, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Catch must engage, corner remain square and lift as one piece, then be placed flat with arms reset; candidate requires four contact-driven fractures, retained coils, no damage, and complete fragment containment.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual alignment is generic; snap-fit joining and lift verification are meaningfully different from controlled fracture and debris recovery.
